basic_profile.bio: I am a 30-year-old IT specialist from Pennsylvania with a deep interest in historical games and Norse culture. I love hiking in the Pennsylvania Wilds and often share my adventures on Reddit. In my downtime, I enjoy watching shows like 'Vikings' and playing games like Assassin's Creed Valhalla. I'm currently single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. I occasionally check out local subreddits like 'evansville' to stay connected with my community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have worked in IT for over five years. My love for history and gaming is more of a self-taught passion, fueled by countless books and documentaries on Viking history and culture.
